sentences.zh: 我的意思是，女性战斗部队、士兵、军事指挥官，这确实是非洲社会和非洲文化的一个非常显著的特征。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可以一直追溯到库施王国，你知道的，它存在于或曾存在于现代的苏丹境内，大约始于公元前5000年，

sentences.en: ended at about 350 AD.
sentences.zh: 终于公元350年左右。

sentences.en: And there was a period from about 200 BC to about 100, 200 AD, where they actually had, you know, female rulers,
sentences.zh: 在大约公元前200年到公元100、200年左右的这段时期里，她们实际上拥有，你知道的，女性统治者，

sentences.en: the Kandankes, who also led, you know, campaigns against the Egyptians, against the Romans.
sentences.zh: 即坎达克女王，她们还领导了针对埃及人、针对罗马人的战役。

sentences.en: So the most famous is Armani Rainis, who in sort of 26 to 23, 22 BC, you know, fought against the Romans, who had, you know, just conquered Egypt.
sentences.zh: 所以最著名的是阿马尼雷纳斯，她在约公元前26至23、22年左右，抵抗了刚刚征服了埃及的罗马人。

sentences.en: And we're also trying to annex Kush as well.
sentences.zh: 而且他们当时也正试图吞并库施。

sentences.en: I mean, what's interesting, obviously, about the Amazons in sort of the, you know, classical Mediterranean, is that there's a kind of, you know, there's almost an inbittle fear,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于古典地中海时期的亚马逊人，有趣的地方显然在于，有一种，你知道的，几乎是一种根深蒂固的恐惧，

sentences.en: because the Amazons of that ilk are basically like an all-female society who don't even allow men to live in their society.
sentences.zh: 因为那一类亚马逊人基本上是一个全女性社会，甚至不允许男性在她们的社会中生活。

sentences.en: Like, it's very, it's like, what would happen if all the rules of society were completely reversed?
sentences.zh: 就像是，如果所有的社会规则完全颠倒过来会发生什么？

sentences.en: And so I'd say, one thing I would say is that there's a bit more of a balance in the reality of the African societies,
sentences.zh: 所以我想说，我要说的一点是，在非洲社会的现实中存在着更多的平衡，

sentences.en: but you can definitely see why that attitude of Amazons, or at least the perception of Amazons, came across to the Europeans who were, or Meditarians, ancient Meditarians, whoever,
sentences.zh: 但你绝对可以理解为什么亚马逊人的那种态度，或者至少是对亚马逊人的这种看法，会传给那些曾遭遇过这些女性指挥官和女兵的欧洲人——或者地中海人、古代地中海人，无论是谁——她们在无数的非洲社会和文化中存在了两千年之久。

sentences.zh: 所以，当欧洲人去到非洲时，我的意思是，显然这一切都反映了这种迷恋，

sentences.en: So, when Europeans go to Africa, and, I mean, obviously all this reflects this kind of fascination,
sentences.zh: 这种很可能带有强烈性化色彩的、对妙龄女战士的迷恋，

sentences.en: and this sort of belief that it's exotic, but it's also forbidden, it's transgressive, and all of this sort of stuff.

sentences.en: Is there any sense, I mean, I know we're massively generalizing, because we're talking about different societies at different points in time,
sentences.zh: 但你认为在非洲是否和欧洲一样，人们觉得女战士是越轨的，但同时某种程度上也很性感、光芒四射，

sentences.en: but do you think there's a sense in Africa, as there is in Europe, that female warriors are transgressive, but sort of also sexy, as it were, glamorous,

sentences.en: I would say actually mundane, just because, you know, like I said, in Africa tends to be, it's not just a feature, for example, of the military,
sentences.zh: 实际上它也是整个社会的一个特征，你在社会中会看到男性职位的女性对应版。

sentences.en: it's actually a feature of all of society, where you're going to have female counterparts to male positions in society.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，例如在库施，在古代库施，实际上，甚至在像9世纪的阿散蒂这样的社会中，甚至在达荷美，

sentences.en: You know, for example, in Kush, you know, in ancient Kush, and actually, you know, even on societies like the 9th century, Asante, even in Dahomey,
sentences.zh: 基本上存在着一种二元论和双重性的意识形态，其本质在于，为了让社会的各个方面能够运转，

sentences.en: there's basically an ideology of duology and dualism, which is essentially that in order for aspects of society to function,
sentences.zh: 你需要一个男性和一个女性的对应部分共同协作。

sentences.en: you need a male and female counterpart working together.
sentences.zh: 这通常也反映在信仰体系中。

sentences.en: And that's often reflected in the belief systems as well.
sentences.zh: 现在，许多这些非洲文化的主要神明通常都是，你知道的，要么它们既是男性又是女性，也就是拥有两种性别，

sentences.en: Now, usually the main gods of, you know, a lot of these African cultures are actually, you know, either they're both male and female, so they're actually of two sexes,

sentences.en: or they're of the two sexes fused into one.

sentences.zh: 所以你甚至可以在政治机构中看到这一点。

sentences.en: and they make him the leader.

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她的军队遭到了毁灭性的打击，她需要更多的士兵。

sentences.en: So she makes a deal with this Mbangala leader called Kassanje.
sentences.zh: 所以她与这个名叫卡桑杰的姆班加拉首领达成了一项交易。

sentences.en: And as part of the deal, she not only has to give up her symbols of royal authority and agree to marry him, but she also has to become an Mbangala herself.
sentences.zh: 作为协议的一部分，她不仅要放弃王权象征并同意嫁给他，还要让自己成为一名姆班加拉人。

sentences.en: So she goes through the rituals to become an Mbangala.
sentences.zh: 所以她经历了成为姆班加拉人的仪式。

sentences.en: And that's a colossal deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨大的交易。

sentences.en: Big deal.
sentences.zh: 大交易。

sentences.en: Huge deal.
sentences.zh: 巨大的交易。

sentences.en: That's giving up her own cultural heritage to embrace that of their traditional enemies, right?
sentences.zh: 这是放弃她自己的文化遗产，去拥抱他们传统敌人的文化，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't consider the Mbangala to be their traditional enemies per se, but it's definitely contrary to Mbundu custom.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不会认为姆班加拉人本身就是他们的传统敌人，但这绝对违背了姆本杜的风俗。

sentences.en: You're totally right in that regard.
sentences.zh: 在这方面你完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, the Mbangala are lawless, like, you know, for the most part.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在很大程度上，姆班加拉人是无法无天的，就像，你知道的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, they live by pillaging and, you know, and some of the things that she has to do, or Elisa said is that she has to do in the Mbangala camp,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们靠掠夺为生，你知道，而且她必须做的一些事情，或者莉莎说她必须在姆班加拉营地做的事情，

sentences.en: including, you know, a blood oath ceremony where she has to drink the blood of the Mbangala and that kind of thing run very contrary to Mbundu customs, exactly like you say.
sentences.zh: 包括，你知道，一个血盟仪式，她必须喝姆班加拉人的血，诸如此类的事情，这与姆本杜的风俗背道而驰，完全如你所说。

sentences.en: Just a quick question on that.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点有个简单的问题。

sentences.en: So I was reading about that, that she drinks human blood.
sentences.zh: 所以我读到过关于这方面的报道，她喝人血。

sentences.en: She has to use some sort of oil made from a slain baby or something.
sentences.zh: 她必须使用某种由被杀害的婴儿或其他东西制成的油。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Crushed baby, one of her attendants.
sentences.zh: 被压碎的婴儿，她的一个随从。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And is that stuff just projection and fantasy, or did that really happen?
sentences.zh: 那些东西只是投射和幻想，还是真的发生了？

sentences.en: You know, it's so difficult to say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很难说。

sentences.en: I mean, given the brutality of the Mbangala,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，鉴于姆班加拉人的残暴，

sentences.en: I'm not, you know, I don't know if I would, you know, rule it completely out.
sentences.zh: 我不是，你知道，我不知道我是否会，你知道，完全排除这种可能。

sentences.en: One thing I would say is that whether or not it was a European invention is something different.
sentences.zh: 我要说的一点是，这是否是欧洲人的发明是另一回事。

sentences.en: It could be a Portuguese invention, but then again, I wouldn't necessarily blame the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 这可能是葡萄牙人的发明，但话又说回来，我不一定会责怪葡萄牙人。

sentences.en: It could actually be something that the Mbangala, you know, either say themselves, because their whole thing was about to inspire fear in peoples around the place.
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能是姆班加拉人，你知道，要么自己说的话，因为他们的全部宗旨就是在周围的人民中激发恐惧。

sentences.en: So it could either be from them or, you know, it's metaphorical, they're different explanations.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能来自他们，或者，你知道，它是隐喻性的，有不同的解释。

sentences.en: But it could actually be, yeah, you know, a real thing.
sentences.zh: 但它实际上可能是，是的，你知道，真实的事情。

sentences.en: Because Nojenga seems to be an absolute liberal.
sentences.zh: 因为诺坚加似乎是一个绝对的自由主义者。

sentences.en: An absolute wuss.
sentences.zh: 一个绝对的懦夫。

sentences.en: So she goes to war with the kingdom of Matamba.
sentences.zh: 所以她对马坦巴王国发动了战争。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: And she conquers them and takes the queen captive.
sentences.zh: 她征服了他们并俘虏了女王。

sentences.en: Yeah, Mwanga, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，姆旺加，是的。

sentences.en: And so she should properly put the queen to death, but instead she, it's very liberal Democrat behavior.
sentences.zh: 所以她本应该把女王处死，但相反她，这非常符合自由民主党的行为。

sentences.en: She just brands her.
sentences.zh: 她只是给她打上烙印。

sentences.en: Oh, Tom, that's just, that's snowflakery, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 哦，汤姆，这简直是，那是温室里的花朵行为，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolute snowflakery.
sentences.zh: 绝对是温室里的花朵行为。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, especially this time, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特别是在这个时候，是的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And takes her daughters into service as her warriors.
sentences.zh: 并把她的女儿们收编为她的战士。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Well, she, yeah, she adopts her daughter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她，是的，她收养了她的女儿。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说的对。

sentences.en: Doesn't slay Mwanga, the queen of Matamba.
sentences.zh: 没有杀死马坦巴女王姆万加。

sentences.en: Brands her and sends her into exile to rule another part of the kingdom.
sentences.zh: 而是给她打上烙印，并将她流放到王国的另一个地区去统治。

sentences.en: But she dies shortly afterwards.
sentences.zh: 但不久之后她就去世了。

sentences.en: Snowflakery.
sentences.zh: 真是太玻璃心了。

sentences.en: Yeah, snowflakery.
sentences.zh: 对，就是玻璃心。

sentences.en: But I think it's partly because she has a reverence for royalty.
sentences.zh: 但我认为部分原因是因为她对王室怀有一种敬意。

sentences.en: I think that was actually it, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得实际上就是这样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So it's like Elizabeth I not wanting to kill Mary, Queen of Scots.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像伊丽莎白一世不想处死苏格兰女王玛丽一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think it's not spilling royal blood.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是不流淌王室血脉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So at this point, is she ruling very much as a queen, i.e. as an identifiably female monarch?
sentences.zh: 那么此时，她在很大程度上是以女王的身份在统治吗，也就是作为一个可辨识的女性君主？

sentences.en: Or is she, you know, doing that thing where she's ruling as a king, but she just happens to be a queen, if you know what I mean.
sentences.zh: 还是说，你知道的，她在扮演那种以国王身份统治、但碰巧是个女王的角色，如果你懂我的意思的话。

sentences.en: So in other words, does she dress and behave as a man or as a woman?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，她的穿着打扮和行为举止是像个男人还是像个女人？

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题。

sentences.en: She definitely doesn't, you know, shy away from being feminine, you know, in certain regards.
sentences.zh: 她绝对没有，你知道的，在某些方面刻意回避女性特质。

sentences.en: Like I said, she has, you know, tons of male concubines, etc.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，她拥有，你知道的，成群的男妃等等。

sentences.en: But then there is also that behavior where she makes her, some of her male concubines, you know, dress up as women and then acts as, you know, a man.
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的还有那种行为，她让她的、一些男妃，你知道的，打扮成女人，然后自己表现得像个，你知道的，男人。

sentences.en: So it's part of...
sentences.zh: 所以这是……的一部分

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And her bodyguard is female.
sentences.zh: 而且她的保镖是女性。

sentences.en: So her soldiers are female and her concubines are male.
sentences.zh: 所以她的士兵是女性，她的男妃是男性。

sentences.en: And there's kind of full-scale cross-dressing going on.
sentences.zh: 这里面可以说是存在着全面彻底的异装。

sentences.en: I mean, she has, yeah, like you said, close female, you know, attendants and generals and all the rest of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她有，对，就像你说的，关系亲密的女性，你知道的，随从、将军以及其他所有人。

sentences.en: And who exactly those were, we're not sure.
sentences.zh: 至于这些人到底是谁，我们并不确定。

sentences.en: But she also has female concubines.
sentences.zh: 但她也有女妃。

sentences.en: But then also that wasn't unusual in terms of, you know, women being allowed to have relationships with multiple men.
sentences.zh: 不过这在当时也并不罕见，你知道的，女性被允许与多名男性保持关系。

sentences.en: And especially if they're royal women, you see it in other places as well.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果她们是王室女性，你在其他地方也能看到这种现象。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so what's happening with Kassanjay, meanwhile, because he doesn't seem the kind of guy who would necessarily be happy
sentences.zh: 那么卡桑加（Kassanjay）在此期间情况如何，因为他看起来不像是那种一定会高兴的人

sentences.en: with his wife keeping large numbers of men dressed as women.
sentences.zh: 看到自己的妻子养着一大群打扮成女人的男人。

sentences.en: Yeah, with concubines.
sentences.zh: 对，还有男妃。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, Kassanjay himself has, you know, says he has up to like 30 sons or something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，卡桑加自己，你知道的，说他有多达30个左右的儿子。

sentences.en: He's a lad.
sentences.zh: 他可真是个风流人物。

sentences.en: So, I mean, he's probably busy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，他可能很忙。

sentences.en: He's probably busy himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己大概就很忙。

sentences.en: But that's true.
sentences.zh: 但确实如此。

sentences.en: But how are they getting on?
sentences.zh: 不过他们现在相处得怎么样？

sentences.en: Are they still a fixture?
sentences.zh: 他们依然是一对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, there's still, you know, in lines between them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们之间，你知道的，还是有些界限的。

sentences.en: How strong this is after the conquest of, because she's still using, you know, in Bangala forces, she uses them to conquer, you know, to conquer Matamba.
sentences.zh: 在征服之后，这种关系有多牢固呢，因为她仍然在利用，你知道的，姆班加拉（Mbangala）军队，她利用他们去征服，你知道的，去征服马坦巴。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, afterwards, Kassanjay also wants to found his own kingdom, actually.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，在此之后，卡桑加其实也想建立自己的王国。

sentences.en: So he's sort of getting closer with the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 所以他有点在和葡萄牙人走得更近。

sentences.en: So there does seem to be a freezing of relations between them, but she's still relying on his, you know, his quote unquote manpower.
sentences.zh: 因此他们之间的关系似乎确实出现了一段冰冻期，但她仍然依赖他的，你知道的，他所谓的兵力。

sentences.en: And so she, what is it, going into the kind of the 1630s, she becomes more and more powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以她，怎么说呢，进入17世纪30年代后，她的权力变得越来越大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: She enters into an alliance with the Dutch.
sentences.zh: 她与荷兰人结成了同盟。

sentences.en: She starts supplying them with slaves.
sentences.zh: 她开始向他们供应奴隶。

sentences.en: Well, that's an interesting point, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个很有意思的点，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because that goes back to that thing we were talking about at the beginning about the...
sentences.zh: 因为这回到了我们一开始讨论的那个关于……的问题

sentences.en: The Dahomey.
sentences.zh: 达荷美。

sentences.en: Yeah, the Dahomey, the warriors of Dahomey.
sentences.zh: 对，达荷美，达荷美的战士。

sentences.en: So she is slave taking.
sentences.zh: 所以她在捕捉奴隶。

sentences.en: That's a pretty established military practice.
sentences.zh: 那是一种相当成熟的军事做法。

sentences.en: Is it for the, for that kingdom?
sentences.zh: 这是为了那个王国吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, when it comes to Africa, obviously there's two kinds.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道的，当谈到非洲时，显然有两种情况。

sentences.en: So the slavery that's happening in Africa, i.e. the types of people that Nijinga herself has in her service, are probably better described as serfs.
sentences.zh: 因此，非洲正在发生的奴隶制，即恩津加（Nijinga）本人为其效劳的人的类型，用农奴来形容可能更贴切。

sentences.en: Now this is not to suggeSt...
sentences.zh: 这并不是说……

sentences.en: That it's fun.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: Not that it's fun, but then also that Africans aren't, you know, enslaving people to sell them to, you know, for example, you know, knowing full well
sentences.zh: 倒不是说这有什么好玩的，但同时非洲人也不是，你知道的，为了把人卖给，你知道的，比如说，明知

sentences.en: that they're going to be traded across the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 他们将被跨大西洋贩卖而奴役他人。

sentences.en: But actually what's happening in Africa and the reason Nijinga is angry, for example, with the Portuguese is because they're enslaving largely as well free Mbundu citizens.
sentences.zh: 但实际上非洲发生的事情以及恩津加生气的原因此，比如她对葡萄牙人生气，是因为他们很大程度上也在奴役自由的姆本杜（Mbundu）平民。

sentences.en: So that's an issue.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个问题。

sentences.en: And so by building this alliance with the Dutch and she's got her terrifying husband as well, she's able to essentially to rebuild the power of her own people.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过与荷兰人建立这个同盟，而且她还有一个可怕的丈夫，她基本上能够重建她自己人民的力量。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And she ends up able to essentially kind of reconstitute it and to establish peace treaty with the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 她最终能够基本上将其重新组合，并与葡萄牙人达成和平条约。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: But I mean, she makes an alliance with the Dutch, but the Dutch actually let her down.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，她与荷兰人结盟，但荷兰人实际上让她失望了。

sentences.en: So this is in the 1640s and she agrees to supply...
sentences.zh: 所以这是在17世纪40年代，她同意供应……

sentences.en: Oh, well.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧。

sentences.en: So off on the way with the Dutch, Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，所以和荷兰人的事就这样了。

sentences.en: So off on the way.
sentences.zh: 所以就这么结束了。

sentences.en: You know, they form an alliance in the 1640s and they're supposed to storm, you know, Luanda.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在17世纪40年代结盟，他们本应该突袭，你知道的，罗安达（Luanda）。

sentences.en: But what happens is the Portuguese send reinforcements from South America and they start bombarding because the Dutch have taken Luanda.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，葡萄牙人从南美洲派出了增援部队，并开始进行轰炸，因为荷兰人已经占领了罗安达。

sentences.en: Oh, so this is all part of the First World War, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 哦，所以这都是第一次世界大战的一部分，多米尼克。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's a Tom's theory, Luke.
sentences.zh: 这是汤姆的理论，卢克。

sentences.en: Yeah, the Dutch-Portuguese war, global war.
sentences.zh: 对，荷葡战争，全球战争。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It's all part of the Dutch coming into and taking, you know, the Atlantic trade from the, you know, from the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 这都是荷兰人介入并从，你知道的，葡萄牙人手中夺取大西洋贸易的一部分。

sentences.en: But also in South America as well.
sentences.zh: 但也包括南美洲。

sentences.en: I mean, they take, you know, the sugar-producing regions of northeast Brazil.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们占领了，你知道的，巴西东北部的产糖区。

sentences.en: But Nijinga is able to capitalise on it, basically.
sentences.zh: 但恩津加基本上能够利用这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's able to capitalise on it.
sentences.zh: 对，她能够利用这一点。

sentences.en: But like I said, you know, they make a deal to storm the capital and essentially when it looks hopeless, the Dutch go ahead to Luanda and board ships and take off,
sentences.zh: 但就像我说的，你知道的，他们达成协议去突袭首都，基本上当情况看起来无望时，荷兰人径直前往罗安达并登船离开，

sentences.en: you know, whilst Nijinga is waiting, you know, for the order or at least, you know, for them to make their assault, their combined assault on the capital.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，而恩津加还在等待，你知道的，等着命令，或者至少，你知道的，等着他们对首都发起联合进攻。

sentences.en: So then she has to, you know, try other strategies.
sentences.zh: 所以她不得不，你知道的，尝试其他策略。

sentences.en: So what she does is, again, she does this sort of, I mean, two, three-pronged strategy, really.
sentences.zh: 所以她做的是，再次重申，她采取了这种，我的意思是，实际上是两三管齐下的策略。

sentences.en: So from Matamba, which is before she conquers Matamba, she's essentially a guerrilla.
sentences.zh: 所以在马坦巴，也就是在她征服马坦巴之前，她基本上是一个游击队员。

sentences.en: You know, she's engaging in guerrilla warfare.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她在进行游击战。

sentences.en: She doesn't actually have a base until she captures Matamba after instigating the rebellion.
sentences.zh: 在挑起叛乱并攻占马坦巴之前，她实际上并没有根据地。

sentences.en: But she engages, you know, quite a lot with the Capuchin missionaries and she writes to the Pope and she tries to get recognised as a Christian monarch.
sentences.zh: 但她与嘉布遣会（Capuchin）传教士进行了相当多的接触，她给教皇写信，并试图被承认为一个基督教君主。

sentences.en: That's one big thing that she does.
sentences.zh: 这是她做的最重大的一件事。

sentences.en: And does that work?
sentences.zh: 这管用吗？

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 管用的。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, it does.
